title: The analogue of Belinskaya's theorem for measure-preserving flows
summary: We prove the analogue of Belinskaya's theorem for measure-preserving flows: two free ergodic measure-preserving flows whose $\mathrm{L}^1$ full groups are isomorphic as abstract groups are conjugate up to a scalar time change. This answers a question posed by François Le Maître and the author. We show that whenever two free ergodic flows generate the same orbit equivalence relation and one is contained in the other's $\mathrm{L}^1$ full group, their positive half-orbits are commensurate after possibly reversing time. Katznelson's criterion then yields conjugacy after a scalar time change.…
